$comment: Skills the installer copies into .agents/skills (Codex, Pi). Codex lists name and description of every skill there inside about 8,000 characters, then shortens and drops entries. budgetChars caps the sum of id + description lengths and keeps the rest of the 8,000 for paths. Every other skill loads with list_skills and get_skill. ADR-0027; check-router-skills enforces the budget.
